# What keeps a thin build alive in the 5:50-9:00 crowd window?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | movement |
| Result | inconclusive |
| Created | L3.I4 |
| Updated | L3.I5 |

## Hypothesis

A lower dashThreshold (0.3) or an HP-and-levels-first pick text cuts health lost in the 6:00-7:00 crowd compared with the playbook, which lost 143 health in that minute and dashed only at 6:30-6:39.

## Method

Gym starch-knobs-350s (a thin playbook build, 120 hp), 200 s per game: two baseline, two dashThreshold 0.3, one HP-first pick text. Read health lost per minute, dashes with their health, and survival. A lead needs confirmation on the seeker 350 s gym and from 0:00 on fresh seeds.

## Findings

L3.I4, 200 s from the 5:50 starch-bolt gym (a strong build). Baseline lived 1 of 2 (14 damage; died 8:21 to the Fryer King). dashThreshold 0.3 lived 2 of 2 with 113 and 109 damage and 4-6 dashes at 51-81% health. The HP-first pick text died 7:07 with 1 chest. The arms have 1-2 games each and the build was too strong to stand for a thin one, so there is no playbook change. Gym retired.
